mentions.name: cardcast.gg
mentions.description: This web app lets players play Magic: The Gathering with friends remotely using a webcam. It features auto-scan functionality that performs whole-frame card detection on a configurable interval so players can hover over another player's webcam stream and automatically see the actual card, a card view grouped by player to handle the many detected cards, and video streaming powered by LiveKit to replace the previous homebrew implementation.
mentions.problem: Players were having video trouble with the homebrew video stream, and detecting cards required manually clicking on them.
mentions.audience: Magic: The Gathering players who want to play with friends remotely
